data.one_liner: A Dart library that creates random or seedable usernames for emails and user forms.
data.what_it_does: It generates usernames from a base string, optionally adding numbers, prefixes, suffixes, dates, or adjectives. It can also produce a list of usernames and supports custom separators.
use_when: You need quick, deterministic usernames for sign‑up forms or email addresses
You want a lightweight solution without external dependencies
You need seedable output for testing or reproducible results
avoid_when: You need full user authentication or management
You need complex validation beyond simple formatting
strengths: Supports prefixes, suffixes, dates, adjectives, and custom separators
weaknesses: Only generates strings, no validation or uniqueness checks
No Flutter widgets or UI components
